title: MAsS Scan as a Predictor of Morbidity and Mortality in Patients With Liver Disease
official: MAsS Scan as a Predictor of Morbidity and Mortality in Patients With Liver Disease
summary: The purpose of the study is to study the muscle assessment score (MAsS, utilizing MRI, as an objective measure of frailty and muscle composition to serve as a predictor of morbidity and mortality in patients with liver disease.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who are already scheduled for an MRI for routine clinical purposes will be evaluated

Exclusion Criteria:

* \<18 yrs. of age
